subject: Demo timeline at risk — request for trial extension & sandbox top-up
messages:
From: Claire Holt <claire@fabrikate.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo timeline at risk — request for trial extension & sandbox top-up

Hi Stephanie,

Quick note from our end — we hit a blocker in the connector work this morning that prevents us from sending intents to the runtime reliably. The engineering lead dug into logs and attached a short excerpt (integration_log.txt) showing the failing POSTs and a 502 pattern.

We have a customer-facing demo scheduled for 2026-08-25 and realistically need another two weeks to stabilize the connector, run one more end-to-end pass, and finalize the demo flows. Our current sandbox is at ~85% of the trial allocation; if we can get a ~30k token top-up and extend the trial window by 14 days it would keep the demo on track and avoid rescheduling.

Is that something Redwood can approve quickly? If you need more detail I can loop in our infra lead.

Thanks,
Claire Holt
Head of Platform
Fabrikate

Attachment: integration_log.txt (excerpt)

Subject: Re: Demo timeline at risk — request for trial extension & sandbox top-up

Hi Claire — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the log snippet.

Sorry to hear about the 502s. I can help with two things right away:
- Fast approval path for a short trial extension and sandbox credit top-up (I need to confirm final amounts with ops).
- A quick check-in with our Sales Engineering team to see whether a temporary routing/workaround reduces token usage while you stabilize the adapter.

I’m looping in Marissa (CS lead) and Dev (Sales Eng) so we can make a fast call on the credit amount and any mitigations. I’ll follow up within 24 hours with a proposal.

Best,
Stephanie
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: FW: Demo timeline at risk — quick approval request (trial extension + credits)

Team — forwarding Fabrikate's ask. TL;DR: customer needs a 2-week extension and ~30k token top-up to hit their demo window (deal FBRK-2026-0421). They’ve attached logs; the problem looks like transient 502s between their adapter and the runtime.

Can you confirm the following by EOD?
1) Is 30k tokens reasonable as a one-off (or would you prefer to offer 25k + free debug support)?
2) Are there any security/legal approvals required for this customer-facing extension? (I’ve attached the signed_mpa_draft for context — we may not need a new doc but want to avoid surprises.)
3) Any fast mitigations Dev can recommend (rate limiting, smaller batch sizes) that reduce token burn while they fix the adapter?

Notes: this is a mid-market POC on a fast cadence; if we reschedule the demo we risk slipping the quarter’s close. I’m flexible on mix of credits vs. hands-on SE time.

Thanks — please reply with yes/no and recommended package.

—Stephanie

Attachment: signed_mpa_draft.docx (for legal context)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Holt <claire@fabrikate.com>, Fabrikate - Sales Ops <sales@fabrikate.com>

Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2026 16:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo timeline at risk — request for trial extension & sandbox top-up

Hi Claire — quick follow-up with good news. We reviewed the logs and the ask with Sales Engineering and CS. Redwood can approve a two-week trial extension and we’ll provision a 25,000-token sandbox top-up immediately. We’re pairing that with a 2-hour SE session (Dev will schedule) to help stabilize the adapter and walk through recommended batching/rate-limit changes to reduce the chance of repeat 502s.

What to expect next:
- You should see the sandbox top-up appear in the account within 1 business hour.
- Dev will reach out to book a 2-hour debugging session (please suggest 2-3 slots this week).
- I’ve attached a brief usage snapshot so you can plan (trial_usage_report.pdf).

We adjusted from 30k -> 25k to balance cost predictability for the quarter; if we need additional tokens after the SE session we can revisit quickly. I hope this keeps your demo on track for 8/25. If you prefer us to formally extend the trial window on the MPA, say so and I’ll route to Legal for a short addendum.

Thanks — and let me know available slots for the SE pairing.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
